records.notes_source: 100Ω ±1%, 0603, 0.1W, 75V, Fenghua ABD03K1000FT; reuse existing board model. TI SLUAA81A recommends input resistors 20–100Ω. Together with existing 220nF (22us nominal RC), supports optional BQ internal passive fine trim without external FETs/resistors. At 4.2V, two resistors each >=99Ω bound current <=21.22mA even treating internal Rcb=0; either input resistor dissipation <=0.0446W. Enable at most one real cell at a time; cell slots 1..8 and 16 only, mask 0x80FF; never enable shorted VC9..14 or VC15 interval. Active ETA and passive trim must not overlap. Firmware must stop balancing, wait for two fresh scans, then use voltage for decisions; temperature/current limits and BQ finite balancing timeout remain mandatory. See 检查/AFE内均衡零增件修整说明.md. Pin mapping unchanged; inventory calculation only, no tests. Sources: https://www.ti.com/lit/an/sluaa81a/sluaa81a.pdf ; https://www.oneyac.com/product/27807722.html .

records.notes_source: SN74LVC74ADR pin mapping unchanged. FF-A: D1=1, CLK1=MAIN_REQ, /PRE1=1, /CLR1=MAIN_CLR_N=BQ_ALERT_IC_N & BMS_LOCAL_OK, Q1=FET_RELEASE. Fault/permit low asynchronously clears main and LOAD_POWER_VALID; recovery needs a fresh MAIN_REQ edge. MCU alone checks precharge voltage and timer completion before requesting main; no independent hardware PRE_OK interlock remains. FF-B: D2=1, CLK2=PRE_REQ, /PRE2=1, /CLR2=POR_OK_N, Q2=TMR_TRIG; one attempt per powered session, only physical OFF/POR rearms. TPL5111 one-shot timing window and U_GATE1 remain. Firmware requires physical OFF after faults, never automatic reclose. ALERT Pin Config 0x92FC=0x82；Default Alarm Mask 0x926D和运行时AlarmEnable 0x66均屏蔽XCHG bit6/XDSG bit5，避免BOTHOFF启动时死锁。保留SSBC bit15、SSA bit14、PF bit13及需要清锁存的真实保护告警；逐项映射OV/UV/OC/SCD/温度及HWDF，读回配置。若此前选中过6/5，先禁用再清旧锁存并确认ALERT解除；真实保护原因须先记录再按恢复策略清除。HWD有限延时；0x9263/0x9267/0x926B bit1启用保护及CHG/DSG动作。DFETOFF 0x92FB=0x42，FET Options 0x9308=0x2D。参考TI TRM https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluuby2b/sluuby2b.pdf

records.notes_source: TI TPL5111DDCR；DDC/SOT-23-6：1=VDD，2=GND，3=DELAY/M_DRV，4=DONE，5=DRVn，6=EN/ONE_SHOT。本图TMR_SET接7.32kΩ至B0；DONE与EN/ONE_SHOT固定B0，使用one-shot。FF-B Q经R_TIMER_SUPPLY=1kΩ给TMR_VDD供电，FF-B只在PRE_CTRL掉电/POR时复位，MCU不能重触发；DRVn输出TMR_ACTIVE，经U_GATE1与SW_RUN、BMS_LOCAL_OK形成PRECHARGE_WINDOW。复用C_TIMER=100nF跨TMR_VDD-B0。标称tIP≈2.578s、输出高脉冲≈2.528s；FF-Q至关断保守纸面估计约2.87s，适用角落按PRE_CTRL=3.0–3.6V、−40..85°C。温漂取厂商设计最大参数，不是逐颗测试；数据手册未列Ioff，不作Ioff保证。大陆单件价参考DigiKey中国¥10.82（含13%税、MOQ1、Cut Tape）；Digi-Reel另收¥49。采购前刷新库存/报价。资料：https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpl5111.pdf；报价：https://www.digikey.cn/en/products/detail/texas-instruments/TPL5111DDCR/6572460?s=N4Ig7CBcoIYE5QIwA5EGYA0IYBcmZAAcBLKANjDTTAAYBfOoA

records.notes_source: Vishay VO617A-2X007T SMD-4 option 7; manufacturer pinout 1=LED A, 2=LED K, 3=phototransistor E, 4=C. Pins 3/4 are a floating external-side positive-logic EN switch: pin4 takes the receiving system's low-current, precharge-available EN bias through its current-limiting resistor; pin3 drives the common LOAD_POWER_VALID EN bus. All receiver ENs must default low with pull-downs to their own PACK-side return. Keep both output pins isolated from B0/CORE_3V3 and use signal-level current only; verify CTR/temperature margin in external design.
